node.label: Macrosaccadic oscillations
node.definition: A type of saccadic oscillations with brief periods of fixation between saccades (intersaccadic interval approximately 200 msec). Macrosaccadic oscillations (up to 40 degrees) straddle the intended fixation position and show a crescendo-decrescendo pattern.

diseases.label: autosomal recessive cerebellar ataxia-saccadic intrusion syndrome
